description: This file contains exception classes, error handling utilities, and debugging functions for TorchDynamo, a PyTorch component. It defines custom exceptions, error formatting, and stack trace management related to error reporting and graph break handling.

classes.name: TorchDynamoException
classes.description: Base class for all TorchDynamo-specific exceptions, supporting custom attributes for tracer output and execution strategy.

classes.name: InternalTorchDynamoError
classes.description: Subclass of TorchDynamoException for internal errors.

classes.name: ResumePrologueTracingError
classes.description: Subclass of TorchDynamoException for errors during resume prologue tracing.

classes.name: RestartAnalysis
classes.description: Base class for restart analysis exceptions, with optional restart reason.

classes.name: SpeculationRestartAnalysis
classes.description: Subclass of RestartAnalysis for speculation-related restarts.

classes.name: AutogradGradRestartAnalysis
classes.description: Subclass of RestartAnalysis for autograd grad restart scenarios.

classes.name: UnspecializeRestartAnalysis
classes.description: Subclass of RestartAnalysis for unspecialization restarts.

classes.name: CompileCollectiveRestartAnalysis
classes.description: Subclass of RestartAnalysis for collective compile restarts.

classes.name: TensorifyScalarRestartAnalysis
classes.description: Subclass of RestartAnalysis for scalar tensorification restarts.

classes.name: SkipFrame
classes.description: Exception used to skip tracing the current frame.

classes.name: TorchRuntimeError
classes.description: Subclass of TorchDynamoException for runtime errors.

classes.name: InvalidBackend
classes.description: Exception indicating an invalid backend, with a message listing available backends.

classes.name: ResetRequired
classes.description: Exception indicating that torch._dynamo.reset() must be called before changing backends.

classes.name: ShortenTraceback
classes.description: Exception supporting traceback shortening with a reference to the first useful frame.

classes.name: BackendCompilerFailed
classes.description: Exception for backend compilation failures, with methods to remove dynamo frames.

classes.name: Unsupported
classes.description: Main exception class for unsupported operations, with detailed message and stack trace info.

classes.name: UnknownPropertiesDuringBackwardTrace
classes.description: Exception for unknown properties during backward trace.

classes.name: RecompileError
classes.description: Exception indicating a recompile error.

classes.name: InfiniteGeneratorError
classes.description: Exception for exceeding maximum generator yield count.

classes.name: CondOpArgsMismatchError
classes.description: Internal error for argument mismatch in cond().

classes.name: UserError
classes.description: Exception class for user-facing errors, with error type and optional case name.

classes.name: StepUnsupported
classes.description: Exception for unsupported steps during tracing.

classes.name: UnsafeScriptObjectError
classes.description: Exception for unsafe script objects.

classes.name: UncapturedHigherOrderOpError
classes.description: Exception for higher order ops not captured.

classes.name: IncorrectUsage
classes.description: Generic exception for incorrect usage.

classes.name: FailOnRecompileLimitHit
classes.description: Exception for hitting recompile limit.

classes.name: PackageError
classes.description: Exception for package-related errors.

classes.name: ObservedException
classes.description: Base class for exceptions observed during tracing, with stored stack info.

classes.name: ObservedUserStopIteration
classes.description: Observed exception for StopIteration during tracing.

classes.name: ObservedLookupError
classes.description: Base class for lookup errors during tracing.

classes.name: ObservedIndexError
classes.description: Observed IndexError during tracing.

classes.name: ObservedKeyError
classes.description: Observed KeyError during tracing.

classes.name: ObservedGeneratorExit
classes.description: Observed GeneratorExit during tracing.

classes.name: ObservedAttributeError
classes.description: Observed AttributeError during tracing.

classes.name: ObservedRuntimeError
classes.description: Observed RuntimeError during tracing.

classes.name: ObservedNotImplementedError
classes.description: Observed NotImplementedError during tracing.

classes.name: ObservedTypeError
classes.description: Observed TypeError during tracing.

methods.name: exportdb_error_message
methods.description: Generates a URL for export database error documentation based on case name.

methods.name: get_dynamo_observed_exception
methods.description: Returns or creates an observed exception class corresponding to a given exception type.

methods.name: raise_observed_exception
methods.description: Wraps and raises an observed exception within Dynamo's tracing context.

methods.name: handle_observed_exception
methods.description: Handles cleanup after an observed exception during tracing.

methods.name: unimplemented_with_warning
methods.description: Logs a warning and calls unimplemented to handle unsupported features with fallback.

methods.name: format_graph_break_message
methods.description: Formats a detailed message for a graph break, including hints and documentation link.

methods.name: _load_gb_type_to_gb_id_map
methods.description: Loads and caches the mapping from graph break types to IDs from a JSON registry.

methods.name: get_gbid_documentation_link
methods.description: Returns a documentation URL for a given graph break type if available.

methods.name: unimplemented
methods.description: Raises an Unsupported exception to signal a graph break with context info.

methods.name: format_error_msg_verbose
methods.description: Creates a verbose error message including stack trace and code info.

methods.name: format_frame_info
methods.description: Formats code object info into a string.

methods.name: format_skip_frame_message
methods.description: Formats a message indicating a frame was skipped for eager fallback.

methods.name: format_error_msg
methods.description: Formats a concise or verbose error message based on config.

methods.name: filter_stack
methods.description: Filters out internal frames from a stack trace.

methods.name: get_stack_above_dynamo
methods.description: Extracts the call stack above Dynamo frames.

methods.name: get_real_stack
methods.description: Retrieves the real stack trace associated with an exception.

methods.name: remove_resume_prefix
methods.description: Removes resume function prefix from a frame name.

methods.name: collapse_resume_frames
methods.description: Filters out resume frames for cleaner tracebacks.

methods.name: augment_exc_message
methods.description: Augments exception messages with additional context and debugging info.

methods.name: augment_exc_message_with_hop_name
methods.description: Adds higher order operator info to exception messages.
